name: Sabtah
title: Son of Cush
summary: Sabtah was the third son of Cush, who was the son of Ham and grandson of Noah. He is mentioned in Genesis and 1 Chronicles in the genealogies after the flood. Sabtah is regarded as the ancestor of a people in southern Arabia.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the post-flood genealogies
keyEvents.description: Sabtah is listed as the third son of Cush in the genealogy of Noah's descendants, known as the Table of Nations.

keyEvents.title: Repeated in the genealogies of Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Sabta is mentioned again in First Chronicles' review of the genealogies from Adam onward, confirming his place in the line of Cush.

keyEvents.title: Part of Ham's lineage
keyEvents.description: As a descendant of Ham through Cush, Sabta belonged to that branch of Noah's family that settled in Africa and southern Arabia.

keyEvents.title: Ancestor of an Arabian people
keyEvents.description: Sabta is traditionally regarded as the ancestor of a people in southern Arabia, possibly linked to the ancient city of Shabwat in Hadramaut.
